title: 532. Unique Substrings in Wraparound String

examples.explanation: The only substring "a" appears in the wraparound string.
The distinct substrings present are "a" and "c"; "ca", "ac" and "cac" never occur consecutively in the wrap.
Every substring of "zab" occurs in the wrap: "z", "a", "b", "za", "ab", "zab".

hints: For each letter, only the longest valid run ending with that letter matters: it contributes exactly that many new distinct substrings.
Extend the current consecutive run when each new character follows the previous one in the alphabet (wrapping from z to a).
